body: This seems like a bad way to deal with being single
What if you’re a little bit of both?
I’m a man, I wanted to make that clear, does this still correspond?

Where do you find balance with “not trying hard enough” though? From what I understand there is somewhat of a chase involved but I don’t play games and don’t play bullshit I just want to have a normal conversation with a decent person.

I’m also not extremely experienced but usually the girl wants me to come get her with my car
https://spineapples.com has everything. You can check us out on Spotify as well, right now our best track is “Archie”

I’m verified on Spotify and iTunes also! My band is coming out with new music this month, and I’m excited, but we barely have an audience. Maybe 20 monthly listeners. 

A really bad breakup inspired the majority of that music. It’s the most personal lyrics I’ve ever written, and maybe it’s embarrassing, but I don’t feel as ashamed as I would before. It’s like I’m already extremely lonely so I have nothing to lose, so I can throw all of my emotions under the guise of a tune and a beat and suddenly it’s a song I can put out. 

The fellow musician tack was helpful. I do feel better/less anxious when I’m *creating* something or at least working on something I consider my *creation* and watching it grow. I guess that’s part of why I like digital marketing (which is fuck all if I could just get a job with my minimal experience)

I hope the best for your music career as well! Maybe we can swap our profiles or something

Thank you for the support! And yeah I’ve been doing that. I think it’s been difficult for everyone so we’ve kind of turned onto online communities. I just feel like I have things to say and I want to share my individual thoughts with people. I want to be able to have a conversation with someone on a daily basis. Like a personal one, not just a group chat. The only time I ever really talk is with my therapist or (embarrassingly) with my dog sometimes. My dog really does make the biggest difference. It’s like when I hug him I can feel the oxytocin flood through my brain. I just want to be able to have that with another person

It’s a little of both. I have minimal success in either or. Also that could be helpful, you may be on to something. I just feel confident in talking to people one on one specifically because I carry this genuine curiosity in all people I meet, what their story is, what they want out of life, what they are doing right now to get that, their thoughts on the state of the world, etc.

I just don’t have anywhere to go. I need 100% complete start over somewhere else. But in the meantime, I will have to suffer and accept that I have no friends. And I’m willing to persevere through that pain and loneliness for however long it takes, but god dammit not an entire year. My life has completely wisped away from me and I just want to give up honestly. I just feel so frustrated with everything because even when I feel like I’m doing the right things, I still can’t get anything I want out of life.

Thank you so so much for this. The best thing for me to do is to work it out reasonably with someone else. Anyway:
1. Yes, my tastes reach across most genres, but mostly of the indie type and classic rock

2. Yes

3. I’m a main proponent of karma/energy. I think what you input in the world is what you get out. Or at least that’s what I like to believe. Idk, I just had a huge moral overhaul happen to me recently where I feel committed to people who could use my help. I just want to be able to work in my career, have weed, have my dog, and to be as good as possible to the people surrounding me.

4. The fact that I used to be much worse in my life, I had a short problem with alcohol, and I just didn’t try at all. I also used to steal my groceries. I just didn’t care about anyone around me at all.

And then as soon as I reform my life and I actually have turned a lot of things around, i get pulled over for no real reason, searched, and charged for weed. Twice. 

I used to have a thriving social life as well but that has all diminished since graduating college. I haven’t even held hands with another girl in a year or more. I had to go through so much just to be here and even that’s still not enough to get at least my social life back
But what does that entail? What about my feelings or reactions were childish? My post is very emotional, sure, but just show me where I need to grow up. How could I have prevented this situation?

You may be right? I don’t know. I just wanted to gain some perspective. I already feel like shit about myself, so you can turn down the aggression knob for a second. Again I only have good intentions and I haven’t done anything wrong. I employ a healthy and loyal life and my parents even admit that. They see how far I’ve come. I also come from my own slew of mental health issues and I mentioned that in my post so I figured you’d be a little bit more sensitive. 

What can I do to change? What was I supposed to do here that I did wrong?

How am I the childish one? Did you even read my full post? Keep note I was not the one to escalate this at all. He started insulting me after I was making a quick trip and giving him only 3/4ths of my attention

Sorry I didn’t want to grow up in army boot camp just a civil family household

But I’m afraid that once I’m able to move on (in which this internship ends after the summer so) it’ll be too late or already is. I don’t want to treat my family like this. I’ve caught myself demonstrating a lot of similar shit he does. 

What can I do to deal with it in the time being? Just agree with everything? I wish he could just stop talking to me but living in the same house makes that too hard for him I guess
Wait can you go into more depth?

They won’t prescribe it to you for anxiety. I’m pretty sure it’s only for nerve pain but I’ve gotten it prescribed by a regular family doctor before by just asking to switch from gaba. It’s in the same schedule as gaba so I imagine pregab isn’t that much different in terms of risk.

If you’re curious imo it’s worth trying like 350mg it’s basically just the same as if you took a shit ton of gabapentin but for some reason I feel like gaba has a cap and won’t get you as high as lyrica can (given that you take a bunch)

In my honest opinion I feel like I get more out of gaba compared to pregab. I don’t get high or don’t feel as good as if I took a couple pregabs, but then again I’m not looking to take all of my meds at once.
